note: 2026-09-26 Unit 5 rebuild (user direction: rebuild Units 5-7 through the engine, new photos approved). New lesson: drinks split from the old 5.2 (ten items), with coffee and tea moved from the old Meals lesson. Learn holds drinks and the five drinks; drink (the base verb) is practised in I drink ... and Do you drink ...?, and family members drinking are practice on Unit 1 words. A No answer is only offered as text beside its Yes pair.

lesson.title: 5.3 Drinks
lesson.unit_outcome: Name fruit, food and drinks, say what you like, want and need, ask how many and how much, and order politely at a café.
lesson.goal: Recognize and name drinks and five common drinks, say who is drinking them, and say what I drink with drink.
lesson.grammar_function: The grandmother is drinking tea. I drink water every day. Do you drink coffee? Yes, I do.
lesson.prerequisite: 1.2 drinking; 1.4-1.6 family words; 4.5-4.8 every day, in the morning and Do you...?; 5.2 food.
lesson.speaking_outcome: Name a drink and say what I drink every day.
